hema
Old news. India finished fourth at the Asian Games with eighty five medals, twenty one of them gold. By twenty forty one, the count is still quoted in every sports ministry speech.

hema
Old news. Fifteen years ago, diplomacy, sport and policy shared the front page. By twenty forty one, they still share it, and the order depends on the day.

hema
That is what the archive teaches. Reports are always due in a hundred and twenty days, and always read later.
